title: 第4章 你还说是普通同学？
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
梁惟石回到家中，就发现一男一女坐在沙发上正商量着什么。

    左边这位男子，身形魁梧，浓眉大眼，与他长得有几分相似。嗯，正是他一生要强的爸爸梁卫国梁所长。

    而右边这位容貌端庄、和蔼可亲的女士，自然就是他的母亲陶红陶老师。

    对爸妈一起提前下班这件事，梁惟石并不意外，因为他清楚地记得，就是在今天，爸妈做出了一个违背祖宗的决定，为了还债把老家的房子和地给卖了。

    而在两年之后，常吉高速公路正式立项，老家的房子和地都在规划路线之内，征迁获得的补偿超过百万，得知消息的梁惟石差点儿哭晕在厕所。

    “石头，面试考得怎么样？”

    见儿子回来，陶红连忙关切地问了句。

    梁卫国却是沉着脸没有说话，随着儿子逐渐长大，他们父子之间的关系一直都很紧张。

    他嫌儿子不服管，梗着脖子和他喊。

    儿子嫌他啥都管，一天到晚没好脸。

    梁惟石没有回话，而是默默地走上前，张开双手，给了父母一个结结实实的拥抱。

    对他来说，上辈子最大的遗憾，并不是仕途受挫，一蹶不振。而是‘树欲静而风不止，子欲养而亲不待！’

    不知多少次，他梦到年少时牵着父母的手掌，一家人幸福的模样，而当他从梦中醒来，却发现父母早已不在身旁。明明是空荡荡的房间，却塞满了他的孤独和感伤。

    面对着儿子忽如其来的感情流露，梁卫国与陶红都显得十分诧异。

    在两人的记忆里，似乎从儿子上初中之后，就再没有过这种‘求安慰’的撒娇表现了。

    嗯，可能面试没考好，所以心情特别糟！

    梁卫国轻咳了一声，破天荒地用平和的语气说道：“第一次面试缺乏经验，没发挥好也是正常的，这次不行，还有下次嘛。男子汉大丈夫，这算多大点儿事儿？打起精神来。”

    陶红也柔声安慰道：“你爸说的对啊，咱不用失望，也没必要沮丧，下次妈给你报个面试辅导班，多练练就好了！”

    梁惟石站直了身体，伸手揉了揉有些发酸的眼睛，笑着说道：“其实吧，我考得还行。”

    “考了多少分？”梁卫国与陶红心中一动，连忙问道。

    “94.7。”梁惟石故作淡然地回答道。

    对于这个分数，他并不在意，但是他知道，父母十分在意。
content_en:
When Liang Weishi returned home, he found a man and a woman sitting on the sofa discussing something.

The man on the left is tall and tall, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, and looks somewhat similar to him.Well, it was his father Liang Weiguo who was the strongest in his life, Director Liang.

The dignified and amiable lady on the right is naturally his mother, Teacher Tao Hongtao.

Liang Weishi was not surprised that his parents got off work early together, because he clearly remembered that it was today that his parents made a decision that went against their ancestors and sold the house and land in their hometown to pay off debts.

Two years later, the Changji Expressway project was officially approved. The house and land in his hometown were within the planned route. The compensation for the relocation exceeded one million. When Liang Weishi learned the news, he almost fainted in tears in the toilet.

"Shitou, how did the interview go?"

Seeing her son coming back, Tao Hong quickly asked with concern.

Liang Weiguo, however, remained calm and silent. As his son grew up, the relationship between father and son has always been tense.

He felt that his son was disobedient, so he yelled at him while holding his neck.

My son thinks that he cares about everything and is embarrassed all the time.

Liang Weishi did not reply, but walked forward silently, opened his hands, and gave his parents a solid hug.

For him, the biggest regret in his previous life was not that his career was frustrated and unable to recover.Rather, 'The tree wants to be quiet but the wind does not stop; the child wants to be nourished but cannot be kissed!’

Countless times, he dreamed of holding his parents' hands when he was young, and the family looked happy. But when he woke up from the dream, he found that his parents were no longer around.The room was obviously empty, but it was filled with his loneliness and sadness.

Faced with their son's sudden display of affection, both Liang Weiguo and Tao Hong looked very surprised.

In their memories, it seems that since their son entered junior high school, there has never been such a coquettish display of 'seeking comfort'.

Well, maybe I didn’t do well in the interview, so I was in a bad mood!

Liang Weiguo coughed slightly and said in a calm tone for the first time: "It's normal for me to not perform well because I lack experience in the first interview. If it doesn't work this time, there will be another time. Man, how big a deal is this? Cheer up."

Tao Hong also comforted her softly: "Your dad is right. We don't need to be disappointed or depressed. Next time, mom will sign you up for an interview coaching class. Just practice more!"

Liang Weishi stood up straight, stretched out his hand to rub his sore eyes, and said with a smile: "Actually, I did pretty well in the exam."

"How many points did you get in the test?" Liang Weiguo and Tao Hong asked quickly with their hearts moving.

"94.7." Liang Weishi replied pretending to be indifferent.

He doesn't care about this score, but he knows that his parents care very much.
title_en: Chapter 4 You still say we are ordinary classmates?
